key_developments: Democrats increasingly optimistic about recapturing Senate majority, with competitive races in Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Ohio, and Texas—states Trump won by double digits in 2024.

Data center development and AI regulation emerge as major midterm issues, with Trump's support for data centers conflicting with Republican candidates' efforts to distance themselves from the issue in battleground races.

Trump's aggressive primary endorsements have unseated multiple GOP incumbents, but those Trump-backed candidates are underperforming in general election matchups, creating vulnerability for Republicans.
Michigan's 50-plus voters and older demographics in swing states show less loyalty to Republicans, with polls indicating El Sayed narrowly leads Rogers despite Democratic weakness nationally.
Texas Senate race unexpectedly competitive, with Democrat James Talarico leading Republican Ken Paxton in multiple polls, raising questions about Republican dominance in the state.

senate.label: TX Senate: Talarico (D) vs. Paxton (R)
senate.note: Democrat James Talarico has led Paxton in multiple polls; Texas hasn't elected a Democrat to Senate in nearly four decades but GOP insiders acknowledge the streak is in trouble.

senate.label: MI Senate: El Sayed (D) vs. Rogers (R)
senate.note: Abdul El Sayed narrowly leads Rogers 48-47 in AARP poll, but struggles with voters 50 and older, a key swing demographic.

senate.label: IA Senate: Open Seat
senate.note: Democrats testing whether Iowa is still a swing state; cancer and healthcare among top issues for voters alongside general Trump midterm concerns.

senate.label: OH Senate: Open Seat
senate.note: Democrats mounting competitive campaign in state Trump won by double digits; transgender athlete policy dividing Democratic messaging approach.

senate.label: KS Senate: Open Seat
senate.note: Democrats competitive in state Trump won by double digits in 2024.

senate.label: AK Senate: Open Seat
senate.note: Democrats mounting competitive campaign in state Trump won by double digits.

house.label: PA-07: Cognetti (D) vs. Republican
house.note: Democrat Paige Cognetti invoking state's industrial past against corporate interests, with AI and data centers emerging as central campaign issues.

house.label: WI Governor: Crowley (D) vs. Tiffany (R)
house.note: Democrat David Crowley holds narrow lead over Trump-endorsed Republican Tom Tiffany in first post-primary poll; positioned as one of most competitive 2026 races.

governor.label: WI Governor: Crowley (D) vs. Tiffany (R)
governor.note: Democrat David Crowley holds narrow lead over Trump-endorsed Republican Tom Tiffany; one of most competitive gubernatorial contests in 2026.

governor.label: TX Governor: Abbott (R) vs. Hinojosa (D)
governor.note: Greg Abbott's lead over Democrat Gina Hinojosa grew in latest poll, contrasting with competitive Senate race in state.

governor.label: MD Governor: Moore (D) Reelection
governor.note: Gov. Wes Moore running for reelection and leading Democratic initiative to elect more Black governors nationwide; rumored 2028 presidential contender.
